label: Capacity
definition: Organic design capacity (p.e.) of the waste water treatment plant

label: Collecting system connection
definition: Specification of the existing wastewater treatment plant (UWWTP) (in operation) or a collecting system without UWWTPs. Article 3; Article 6.

label: Nature based secondary treatment
definition: NBS is used as the main technology for secondary treatment (unconventional treatment) of urban wastewater. If NBS is used as an additional treatment technology after conventional (mechanical-biological) treatment, select 'No'.

label: Treatment remarks
definition: Other remarks to types of treatment

label: Performance TSS
definition: Treatment performance: TSS (pass/fail/not relevant). Article 22(1)(a); Article 21(1)(a); Article Annex I (Tab.1).

label: Performance BOD
definition: Treatment performance: BOD5 (pass/fail/not relevant). Article 22(1)(a); Article 21(1)(a); Article Annex I (Tab.1).

label: Performance COD
definition: Treatment performance: COD (pass/fail/not relevant). Article 22(1)(a); Article 21(1)(a); Article Annex I (Tab.1).

label: Performance TOC
definition: Treatment performance: TOC Note: MS shall measure either the COD or TOC; also can replace BOD5 if relationship can be established. Article 22(1)(a); Article 21(1)(a); Article Annex I (Tab.1).

label: Performance nitrogen
definition: Treatment performance: N (pass/fail/not relevant). Article 22(1)(a); Article 21(1)(a); Article Annex I (Tab.2).
condition: Required if `generatedLoad` of the agglomeration is 10 000 p.e. or more

label: Performance phosphorus
definition: Treatment performance: P (pass/fail/not relevant). Article 22(1)(a); Article 21(1)(a); Article Annex I (Tab.2).
condition: Required if `generatedLoad` of the agglomeration is 10 000 p.e. or more

label: Incoming load BOD method
definition: Method of BOD5 incoming load determination (determined from the annual average BOD concentration and the annual volume of wastewater treated).

label: Discharged load BOD method
definition: Method of BOD5 discharged load determination.

label: Incoming load COD
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationCOD` is empty and `outflowConcentrationTOC` is empty and (`incomingLoadTOC` is empty or `dischargedLoadTOC` is empty)

label: Incoming load COD method
definition: Method of COD incoming load determination.

label: Discharged load COD
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationCOD` is empty and `outflowConcentrationTOC` is empty and (`incomingLoadTOC` is empty or `dischargedLoadTOC` is empty)

label: Discharged load COD method
definition: Method of COD discharged load determination.

label: Incoming load TOC
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationCOD` is empty and `outflowConcentrationTOC` is empty and (`incomingLoadCOD` is empty or `dischargedLoadCOD` is empty)

label: Incoming load TOC method
definition: Method of TOC incoming load determination.

label: Discharged load TOC
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationCOD` is empty and `outflowConcentrationTOC` is empty and (`incomingLoadCOD` is empty or `dischargedLoadCOD` is empty)

label: Discharged load TOC method
definition: Method of TOC discharged load determination.

label: Incoming load nitrogen
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationNitrogen` is empty and `loadEntering` is 150 000 p.e. or more, or 10 000 p.e. or more with a discharge point in a sensitive area

label: Incoming load nitrogen method
definition: Method of Total Nitrogen incoming load determination.

label: Discharged load nitrogen
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationNitrogen` is empty and `loadEntering` is 150 000 p.e. or more, or 10 000 p.e. or more with a discharge point in a sensitive area

label: Discharged load nitrogen method
definition: Method of Total Nitrogen discharged load determination.

label: Incoming load phosphorus
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationPhosphorus` is empty and `loadEntering` is 150 000 p.e. or more, or 10 000 p.e. or more with a discharge point in a sensitive area

label: Incoming load phosphorus method
definition: Method of Total Phosphorus incoming load determination.

label: Discharged load phosphorus
condition: Required if `outflowConcentrationPhosphorus` is empty and `loadEntering` is 150 000 p.e. or more, or 10 000 p.e. or more with a discharge point in a sensitive area

label: Discharged load phosphorus method
definition: Method of Total Phosphorus discharged load determination.

label: Outflow concentration BOD
condition: Required if (`incomingLoadBOD` is empty or `dischargedLoadBOD` is empty)

label: Samples collected
definition: Number of samples collected (per year) - complete samples (organics+nutrients). Article 21(1); Annex I-Part C.

label: Samples failed
definition: Number of samples failed (per year) (one out all out). Article 21(1); Annex I-Part C.

label: Wastewater treated
definition: Mean annual volume of waste water treated (m3/year)
